findings.text: Clear operation prepares a staged edit that detaches the whole tree. If no root exists there is nothing to do. Otherwise it records the array and operations, points one staged assignment at the root with an empty destination, and marks the old root as the excised subtree for later deferred release.

Apply operation publishes a previously staged edit to readers, refreshes aggregate leaf counts, and schedules deferred reclamation of replaced storage. Publication is ordered in stages with barriers, count adjustment walks toward the root through intervening indirection, and an empty root resets the tree count.

Garbage collection builds a replacement tree containing only objects accepted by a caller supplied retention predicate, then publishes it as one edit. It duplicates the reachable structure, filters leaves, compresses sparsely populated nodes, removes redundant indirection, and reports allocation failure without changing the original tree.

Delete tail logic decides whether a shrunken branch can be collapsed. It may reuse an ancestor with few enough leaves or otherwise allocates a fresh node, copies surviving entries except the removed leaf, rewires the parent linkage for root and non-root cases, and marks the old subtree excised. Allocation failure cancels the edit and reports out of memory.

Generic 64 bit atomic read and write provide locked access to a counter. Read returns the current value and write stores a supplied value, each under mutual exclusion that also preserves interrupt state.

Generic 64 bit arithmetic and logic update family provides plain update, update with new value returned, and update with old value returned. Covered operations include addition, subtraction, logical combination and masked forms, all performed atomically with respect to other users of the same hashed lock.

Generic 64 bit conditional and exchange operations provide decrement only when the predecessor stays nonnegative, compare and exchange returning the observed old value, unconditional exchange, and conditional addition unless a forbidden value is observed. Each observes and conditionally stores under one critical section.

Test module provides an init routine that exercises 32 and 64 bit atomic interfaces and a matching exit routine. Init runs deterministic value checks across plain, acquire, release and relaxed spellings and logs a platform summary where applicable.

Per branch leaf totals and the tree total move together when an edit is published. An adjustment amount is added along the ancestry path and to the tree total, while replacing the root with emptiness resets the tree total to zero.

Collapsed replacement nodes preserve linkage and accounting of the node they replace, including ancestry linkage, slot identity and branch leaf total, while omitting exactly the deleted leaf. The iteration is expected to fill one fewer slot than the preserved total.

Garbage collection only retains leaves approved by the predicate and never moves internal entries into leaf positions during folding. Compression preserves total leaf membership while reducing depth and redundant indirection.

Generic atomic updates are linearizable with respect to one hashed lock selected from the object address. Each operation holds that lock for the whole read, modify and write sequence with interrupts preserved across the critical section.

Generic 64 bit atomics serialize on a small table of spin locks indexed by a hash of the shifted object address. Callers save interrupt state, acquire the selected lock, touch only the associated counter, release the lock, then restore interrupt state.

Hashed lock table holds sixteen entries, each pairing one spin lock with padding sized to a first level cache line and aligned to avoid false sharing. Indexing masks the mixed address hash to the table size.

Edit object observed here stages deferred publication and reclamation: direct leaf assignment, parent slot assignments, backpointer assignments, generic pointer assignments, count adjustment target and delta, dead leaf, excised metadata, excised subtree with its operations, array linkage, and a deferred cleanup hook.

Publication proceeds through ordered phases: leaf assignment becomes visible, then parent slot assignments, then backpointer assignments, then generic assignments, each separated by a write barrier. Counts are adjusted afterwards and replaced storage is handed to deferred reclamation.

Collection proceeds as descend and duplicate, filter leaves at each node, compress upward by folding small children into free slots, excise nodes occupied only by indirection, remove indirection above leaf only nodes, ascend the old tree to the next slot, and finally publish the new root and tree total.

Allocation failure during delete collapse, clear preparation, or collection leaves the live tree unchanged. Delete cancels its staged edit, clear reports failure directly, and collection destroys only the partially built replacement plus its edit object.

Reclamation is deferred until readers have passed a grace period. Cleanup then releases the dead leaf through an operations callback, frees excised metadata nodes, detaches and destroys the excised subtree with its recorded operations, and finally frees the edit object.

Internal consistency checks treat several states as fatal, including a leaf valued backpointer where a node is required during collapse, a non node ancestor during count adjustment, unexpected metadata during folding, and excising a leaf as if it were a subtree.
Number of generic atomic hash locks is sixteen.
